text: Entry Requirements In order to be considered for admission, you must: -be a non-Chinese citizen, 18-45 years old, in good health, -have completed senior high school education or will receive a high school diploma by the summer before matriculation at SUFE in September 2026, AND -meet the Chinese language requirements through HSK: If your intended major is Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages , the entry requirement is HSK 4 ; applicants of other majors should present HSK 5, score 180 or above certification at the time of application. -It is mandatory to take the CSCA test and get the score report in advance. All the applicants, no matter which major you apply for, must sit the Math test. You can choose either Chinese test or English test. Humanities Chinese test result is not required if your intended major is Teaching Chinese to speakers of Other Languages. Applicants of other majors must take Humanities Chinese test. Important: It is advisable to take the CSCA test at an early date. The CSCA tests are designed to provide an objective measure of a student's proficiency in core subjects such as Math, Chinese language, and the test scores play a crucial role in the admission decision making process.
